label: GOLDEN-VEXRISCV-LIVE-JTAG-UART

authorization.user_statement: 目前Flash中存储的是成功启动的vexriscv（a10-linux-riscv），可以添加一个任务，看如何用当前的设备进行串口交互。直接使用这个命令行即可读取和交互。
excluded: starting or stopping a JTAG server

first_direct_attempt.result: No matching JTAG UART was initially enumerated; terminal exited naturally.

enumeration_refresh.result: Read-only jtagconfig -n exposed JTAG UART #0 without restarting jtagserver or reconfiguring the FPGA.

connected_session.target_output: PASS; received the running VexRiscv Linux log from kernel command line through riscv-plic initialization
connected_session.last_line: riscv-plic: plic@c000000: mapped 32 interrupts with 1 handlers for 1 contexts.
connected_session.input: A newline and echo T20260920_003_GOLDEN_RX_OK were transmitted once after the log remained quiet.
connected_session.input_result: No input echo, marker output, /init line or shell prompt arrived before the bounded observation ended.
connected_session.exit: Ctrl-C stopped only the task-owned nios2-terminal; remote command exit 0.

short_reconnect.result: Connected to the same device/instance, but no target output or response to T20260920_003_GOLDEN_RX_RECONNECT_OK was observed; task-owned terminal was stopped with Ctrl-C.

live_observation.classification: The direct command and target-to-host JTAG-UART path work. The currently running golden CPU did not reach an interactive shell during this bounded no-reset observation, so this run cannot establish current host-to-target shell input.

historical_success_control.method: Start-Process nios2-terminal with the same cable/device/instance, ordinary-file RedirectStandardInput and --quit-after=20
historical_success_control.conclusion: The exact host tool path has a recorded successful bidirectional interaction when the golden Linux instance has reached its shell.

operational_finding.symptom: After a nios2-terminal exits, the next direct attempt or first jtagconfig scan can temporarily show no JTAG UART even though FPGA device 0x02E060DD remains visible.
operational_finding.non_destructive_recovery_observed: Allow the existing standard server to rescan with read-only jtagconfig -n; after a short delay a subsequent scan exposed JTAG UART #0, without restarting PID 5640.
operational_finding.final_node_state: At 2026-09-20T02:02:37+08:00 JTAG UART #0 was visible, standard jtagserver PID 5640 remained alive and no nios2-terminal process remained.

blocker: The current golden VexRiscv Linux instance emitted kernel output but did not advance past the observed PLIC initialization to /init or vex # during the bounded no-reset session.
next: Keep the current board untouched. Continue T-20260920-001 locally. A fresh golden boot with terminal attached from the start would require separate reset/power-cycle authorization outside this goal's safety boundary.
